role: Pilot-track student, a year or two ahead of Section Nine -- GM-ONLY: a Cicada Cadre member and a Directorate Frame pilot
description: Confident, a little competitive, not actually malicious -- eats in the same canteen as Section Nine and has an opinion about their assignment, first met casually there (data/scene-briefs/episode-c1e1--canteen.json). GM-ONLY, never surfaced at the table until his own reveal: he is a Directorate Frame pilot who went to one of Cicada's recruitment shows, was shown the Watcher undeniably, and stayed rather than walking out the way Nozomi did on the same kind of night. He is Cicada's intelligence source (Directorate movements, rosters, deployments) and, later, the Cadre's escalation -- the only one of the four who will kill, having done so once already by panic rather than intent, and built a doctrine backward to survive having done it. The party fights him masked in a warehouse long before they learn who he is.
